description: This script generates and manages OCSP responses and certificates, including creating certificates, responses, and handling OCSP request/response encoding, signing, and storage.

classes.name: rfc2459.Extension
classes.description: Represents an X.509 extension with methods to set components.

classes.name: rfc2560.ResponderID
classes.description: Represents a responder identifier in OCSP responses.

classes.name: rfc2560.SingleResponse
classes.description: Represents a single OCSP response for a certificate.

classes.name: rfc2560.ResponseData
classes.description: Contains response data for OCSP responses.

classes.name: rfc2459.AlgorithmIdentifier
classes.description: Represents an algorithm identifier in X.509 certificates.

classes.name: rfc2560.BasicOCSPResponse
classes.description: Contains the basic OCSP response data including signature.

methods.name: SigAlgOid
methods.description: Returns the signature algorithm OID based on input string ('sha1' or default to sha256).

methods.name: CreateCert
methods.description: Generates a new X.509 certificate with optional signer and OCSP extension.

methods.name: CreateExtension
methods.description: Creates an X.509 extension with specified OID and critical flag.

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Generates a ResponderID based on certificate subject.

methods.name: GetKeyHash
methods.description: Generates a ResponderID based on the public key hash of a certificate.

methods.name: CreateSingleResponse
methods.description: Creates an OCSP SingleResponse object with certificate status and optional revocation info.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an OCSP Response object with optional responses, extensions, and signature.

methods.name: MakePemBlock
methods.description: Encodes DER data into PEM format with headers.

methods.name: WriteStringToFile
methods.description: Writes string data to a specified file.

methods.name: ReadFileToString
methods.description: Reads string data from a specified file.

methods.name: CreateOCSPRequestDer
methods.description: Uses OpenSSL to generate a DER-encoded OCSP request for given issuer and cert PEMs.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Stores OCSP response data and related certificates into a PEM file with embedded request.
